note: Real games carry no byte patches until a maintainer verifies offsets against a specific build (see README). demo_game is fictional test data.

games.name: Max Payne
games.blurb: Runs the original on Windows 10 and 11 and adds widescreen.
launch_notes: Install the fix pack in step 3, then start the game the way you normally do (Steam, or MaxPayne.exe).
In the game's Options, choose your screen's resolution.
If it will not start: use Remove in step 3, then try the compatibility options in step 2 one at a time, testing after each.

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl (original 2007 game)
games.blurb: Compatibility settings for the original game (xr_3DA.exe).
launch_notes: This entry is for the original 2007 game. The Legends of the Zone Trilogy Enhanced Edition is an official modern release: start it from your game store first, it usually needs no changes.
No file fixes are bundled for this game. Turn on one compatibility option at a time in step 2 and test after each.
If your version uses a different .exe, add it with 'Other game' instead.

games.name: Other game (any .exe)
games.blurb: Compatibility settings for any game: you choose its .exe.
launch_notes: Turn on one compatibility option at a time in step 2 and test the game after each one.
Use Undo in step 2 to put Windows back exactly as it was.

games.name: Demo game (for testing the app)
games.blurb: A fake game used to test every feature safely. Never use it for a real game.
games.wiki_text:
[DEMO DATA] Demo game: Fixes
Used only to test the app.
Fix 1 (registry): Open HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\RetroPatcherDemo\DemoGame and set the DWORD value "ForceSingleCore" to 1 and the DWORD value "ScreenWidth" to 1920.
Fix 2 (executable): In DemoGame.exe at offset 0x1A2B3C replace the bytes 74 05 90 90 with EB 05 90 90.
launch_notes: This is a test game. Nothing here affects a real game.
